jobs.title: Product Manager (Build Experience)
jobs.description:
TL;DR 

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the design and visual building experience at Lovable. You'll lead visual editing, content editing, design systems, and theming, all AI-first, making sure that what people build with Lovable is consistent, on-brand, and easy to experiment with.



Why Lovable? 

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.



What we're looking for

 - 8+ years in the software industry, with experience in product management or engineering leadership on design tools, visual editors, or creative platforms (Figma, Canva, Webflow, or similar)

 - Deep understanding of design systems, theming, typography, and layout, and a sharp eye for what makes visual output feel professional rather than amateur

 - Experience thinking about design in an AI-first context, including how generative AI can produce, adapt, and maintain visual quality at scale

 - Technical curiosity: you don't need to code, but you understand how design tools and AI systems work under the hood well enough to make good product calls

 - Preferred: Prior experience closing the gap between AI-generated output and genuinely designed experiences; strong opinions on how AI should make design decisions on behalf of users



What you'll do

 - Represent the user. Bring findings on design quality, visual editing workflows, and content creation patterns to the team with clarity and conviction

 - Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, usability testing, data analysis, and crafting messaging for upcoming features

 - Own the design quality bar. Make sure AI-generated outputs are consistent, on-brand, and give users the confidence to experiment freely and ship

 - Scope ruthlessly. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't

 - Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to talk about design features accurately and confidently

 - Projects you'll tackle first: Auditing the current state of AI-generated visual output and defining the quality gaps; owning the first iteration of a coherent theming and design system experience; running discovery on the visual editing workflows users rely on most and where they break down



About your application 

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

What we're looking for

 - 8+ years in the software industry, with exposure to security, trust & safety, or platform integrity in a product management or engineering leadership role

 - Familiarity with the security challenges unique to AI-generated software, including code vulnerabilities, prompt injection, and unsafe defaults, and how to build secure-by-default experiences users don't have to think about

 - Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on threat models, vulnerabilities, and platform architecture

 - Strong product sense and systems thinking. You know how to translate security constraints into good user experiences rather than friction, and you have sharp opinions on when security should be invisible vs. unmistakable

 - Preferred: Prior experience working on platform security or trust & safety at scale; familiarity with enterprise security requirements and how they influence product decisions

 - Represent the user. Bring findings on security posture, threat models, and trust signals to the team with clarity and conviction

 - Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, data analysis, and crafting security messaging that resonates with both technical and non-technical users

 - Shape how security surfaces across the product, spanning AI output review, permissions, publishing safeguards, and vulnerability detection

 - Scope ruthlessly. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't

 - Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to speak credibly about security, especially for enterprise buyers where it's a dealbreaker

 - Projects you'll tackle first: Mapping the current threat surface across Lovable-generated apps and defining the biggest gaps; owning the first iteration of secure-by-default publishing safeguards; building the internal framework for how security features get scoped, prioritized, and communicated across the company

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
TL;DR - Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.

You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.



Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.



Who you are

 - A clear, sharp writer, able to explain a complex feature in an email subject line or an in app tooltip.

 - Strong at positioning: you can look at a user segment and a product moment and know what story will resonate.

 - Comfortable partnering closely with a Growth PM and a Lifecycle team without needing to own their roadmap or tooling.

 - Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority.

 - Curious about data and results, even if you're not the one running the experiments; you want to know what messaging is working and why.

 - Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles.



What we’re looking for

 - 10+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles.

 - Experience at a high tech company.

 - Direct experience writing messaging and positioning for a PLG or self serve product, ideally across the signup to paid to expansion journey.

 - A track record of writing customer facing content, campaigns, or messaging that you can speak to in detail, and that you can point to measurable outcomes for.

 - Experience partnering with product, growth, or lifecycle teams to bring messaging into their workflows, without owning the underlying roadmap or systems.
   
   Preferred: 

 - Experience working alongside lifecycle or CRM tools such as Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io http://Customer.io, even if you weren't the one operating them.

 - Familiarity with growth metrics and experimentation frameworks (PQLs, activation rate, feature adoption) enough to speak the same language as a Growth PM.

 - Experience working with developer, startup, or solo builder audiences.

 - Experience building messaging frameworks or toolkits that scaled across multiple teams.



What you’ll do

 - Own messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey, from signup through activation and expansion.

 - Partner with the Growth PM to translate their roadmap and experimentation priorities into strong, on-brand messaging, bringing your own point of view on framing and positioning rather than just executing briefs.

 - Work hand in hand with the Lifecycle team on new content and messaging for email, in-app surfaces, and push notifications, ensuring everything reflects our positioning and voice.

 - Develop clear point of view documents and messaging guidance for different self serve segments (solo founders, indie hackers, small teams) that inform both lifecycle content and broader growth campaigns.

 - Write and refine copy for high leverage touchpoints: onboarding flows, activation nudges, upgrade prompts, and in-app messaging.

 - Review and sharpen messaging coming out of experiments and campaigns, helping the team understand not just whether something worked, but why, from a messaging and positioning lens.

 - Build a shared messaging toolkit (voice, tone, positioning by segment, proof points) that Lifecycle and Growth can both draw from.

 - Represent the messaging and positioning perspective in growth planning, as a thought partner to the Growth PM rather than an owner of the roadmap itself.



About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
jobs.description:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.




WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.



We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.



Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.

 - A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.

 - Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.

 - Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.

 - Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.

 - Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.

 - A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.

 - Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.

 - Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.

 - Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.

 - Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.

 - Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.

 - Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.

 - Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.



Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.




ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.
